tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Frank Poncelet's identity: name, role, location, official social links, and biography.

tools.name: get_career
tools.description: Career timeline chapters (Air Force → education → ING → Web3). Optionally filter by era or chapter title.

era.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against a chapter's era or title (e.g. 'ING', 'Blockchain', 'Chapter II').

tools.name: get_projects
tools.description: Selected work. Optionally filter by tag (AI, Fintech, Blockchain, NFT).

tag.description: Case-insensitive tag filter. Known tags: AI, Fintech, Blockchain, NFT.

tools.name: get_speaking
tools.description: Conference talks and panels. Optionally filter by year (e.g. '2024').

year.description: Four-digit year to filter by, e.g. '2024'.

tools.name: get_expertise
tools.description: Domains Frank works in, plus the areas his projects cover.

tools.name: get_engagement
tools.description: How to work with Frank: services offered, what he does not do, and contact paths.

tools.name: get_current_focus
tools.description: Frank's active direction / roadmap — what he is building toward right now.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: Frank's blog posts. Without arguments, lists all posts (metadata + URLs). Pass `slug` for one post including its full markdown content, or `tag` to filter the list. Each post's raw markdown source is also served at <url>.md.

slug.description: Exact post slug (e.g. 'one-file-two-readers') to fetch a single article including its markdown content.

tag.description: Case-insensitive tag filter for the list, e.g. 'ai-agents'.

tools.name: get_persona
tools.description: Frank's full Agent Skill (skill.md) inline. Adopt it to produce output 'as Frank' — it defines his engineering philosophy, decision matrix, voice, and command modes.
